route.state_behavior: After position 0, all 22 recurrent-convolution states are replaced and each of 8 attention K/V pairs writes its 512-element token slice at position 0. Those states are supplied to position 1 without reload.
route.position_behavior: position_ids advances 0 to 1; attention mask opens the prior position and keeps the current final slot visible exactly as in the established route.

timing.interpretation: x86 HTP emulator feasibility diagnostic only; not physical or benchmark performance evidence.

next_gate_boundary: This is the smallest feasible multi-step state/position/mask check. It does not execute the full canonical short prompt or generate text. Physical expansion still requires Pi/Moritz agreement and explicit phone priority.
claim_boundary: Host x86 HTP two-step loaded-state and greedy-decision evidence only. No new physical Android execution, canonical prompt completion, generated-text quality, performance campaign, or registry result.
